Slides are organized by unit and class meeting. For example, **4.1** is the first meeting of Unit 4.

See the [schedule](../2026/schedule.qmd) for meeting dates and preparation. Readings and handouts are available on [Canvas](https://colostate.instructure.com/courses/230315/pages/readings).

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    link.target = "_blank";
    link.rel = "noopener";
  });
});
</script>
```
